# Gustavo Silveira

> Senior Product Designer specializing in AI product design, SaaS interfaces, and early-stage startups. 8+ years of experience designing for products with millions of users (Hotmart) and shipping production code with Claude Code (Duo AI). Available for freelance and contract work.

## Experience

- **Duo AI** (2025–present) — Founding Designer & Product Builder. Designs and ships consumer surfaces in production using Figma + Claude Code.
- **Hotmart** (2021–2025) — UX Designer & Researcher. Worked on Hotmart Club (30M+ users): JTBD journey mapping, design sprints, automated research repository.
- **Sympla** (2019–2020) — UX Designer & Researcher. Event-tech platform.
- **Freelance & Consulting** (2015–present) — Senior UX/UI Designer & Researcher across multiple industries.

## Selected Case Studies

- [Duo AI — Consumer Redesign](https://gustavosilveira.com/portfolio/duo-ai-buyer-redesign): Redesign and implementation of consumer surfaces in Duo AI (sign-in, agents, header, sidebar, light mode), taken from Figma to code using Claude Code.
- [Duo AI — Creator Studio](https://gustavosilveira.com/portfolio/duo-ai-creator-studio): End-to-end product design for the creator side of Duo AI — the studio where creators build and configure AI assistants.
- [Hotmart Club — Creator Journey (JTBD)](https://gustavosilveira.com/portfolio/hotmart-club-jtbd): End-to-end journey mapping using Jobs To Be Done methodology. Adopted as roadmap prioritization reference across multiple product teams.
- [Hotmart — Design Sprint (Personalization)](https://gustavosilveira.com/portfolio/hotmart-design-sprint): 4-day design sprint solving a personalization pain point. Prototype validated in 1 week, shipped in 1 month.
- [Hotmart — Automated Research Repository](https://gustavosilveira.com/portfolio/hotmart-research-repository): Centralized feedback system combining CSAT, NPS, and support data to drive evidence-based product decisions.
- [Sonho Grande — School Dropout Prevention](https://gustavosilveira.com/portfolio/sonho-grande): Web and mobile app for Instituto Sonho Grande to help public school managers monitor dropout risk. UX, UI, and data visualization for social impact.
- [Softruck — Tracking App Redesign](https://gustavosilveira.com/portfolio/softruck-redesign): Complete redesign of a vehicle tracking mobile app — usability, visual design, and feature expansion.
